title: lolium multiflorum var. boucheanum
intro:
Lolium multiflorum var. boucheanum, commonly known as Bouché's Italian ryegrass, is a plant species within the Lolium genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Lolium multiflorum var. boucheanum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve gut microbiota, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
